definitions.anchor_only: One FUNCTION anchor and no other semantic structure; visibility/unknown observability may coexist.
definitions.counts: Canonical nodes/edges (not callsite multiplicities); unresolved occurrences also reported separately.
definitions.interaction_capable: Explicit calls_function edge whose callee is source of calls_api/references_string/uses_constant/belongs_to_section (Step 6).
definitions.observability_complete: All required visibility observations available and no observed incompleteness.
definitions.observability_unknown: Required visibility observation absent/null; unknown is never interpreted as zero.
definitions.observed_incompleteness: Explicit unresolved records/counts or local graph truncation. Observed indirect/dynamic calls alone do not imply incompleteness.
definitions.possibly_incomplete_observability: Union of unknown and observed incompleteness, retaining existing Step 6/7 conservative reporting. No fingerprint motif-budget truncation inferred from canonical input.
definitions.scope: Read-only signal audit; categories overlap; no labels, exclusions, similarity or malware inference.
